data.narrative:
9 Mothers is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Russell Smith, Roman Khomenko, and Bogdan Pyzh, having raised $4.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparative universe of 10 peers across Defense & Security—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $4.5M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage, yielding $11M. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A) produces a median implied value of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide dispersion. The triangulated analysis supports a range of $10M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $206M. This spread reflects fundamental uncertainty: the Stage-Progression method, anchored to actual capital raised, suggests a tighter valuation closer to $10–11M, while the Peer-Median approach suggests substantially higher values if 9 Mothers exhibits comparable characteristics to Series A–stage peers. Key uncertainties include product maturity, revenue traction, and whether peer valuations reflect genuine comparable risk profiles or sector exuberance at the Seed stage.
